This FloPlast push-fit single socket soil pipe in black offers a robust and efficient solution for soil and wastewater drainage systems. Constructed from durable uPVC, this 110mm diameter pipe ensures long-lasting performance, making it a reliable choice for various plumbing installations. The innovative push-fit connection system, combined with secure ring seal joints, allows for quick and straightforward installation without the need for specialist tools, providing a watertight and dependable seal. At 1 metre in length, this soil stack pipe is a versatile component for extensions, renovations, or new build projects.
